# Loader { #timetoalign.loader.Loader }

```python
loader.Loader(seed=None)
```

Shared lifecycle for all loader families.

The root owns source tracking, the ``load`` template, convenience
construction, and timeline-creation surfaces. Payload-specific state and
APIs belong to subclasses such as :class:`EventLoader`,
:class:`ManifestLoader`, and :class:`AlignmentLoader`.

Every ``load``, ``load_*`` and ``create_*`` method of every loader
mints from the loader's minter (see :meth:`load`): the groups, bundles,
maps and flow control it builds without an ID of their own included.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [metadata](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.metadata) | Aggregated source metadata. |
| [sources](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.sources) | The loaded sources: ``Path`` objects and ZIP members (``zipfile.Path``). |

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [clear](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.clear) | Clear shared source state; the next ``load`` seeds as the first did. |
| [create_bundle](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.create_bundle) | Create an alignment bundle when supported. |
| [create_group](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.create_group) | Create a timeline group when supported. |
| [create_timeline](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.create_timeline) | Create a timeline from the loaded payload. |
| [create_timelines](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.create_timelines) | Create all timelines, optionally filtered by an implementation. |
| [from_file](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.from_file) | Instantiate the loader with *kwargs*, load *paths*, and return it. |
| [load](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.load) | Load and accept one or more sources through the shared template. |

### clear { #timetoalign.loader.Loader.clear }

```python
loader.Loader.clear()
```

Clear shared source state; the next ``load`` seeds as the first did.

### create_group { #timetoalign.loader.Loader.create_group }


Concrete loader families implement payload-specific construction.

### from_file { #timetoalign.loader.Loader.from_file }

```python
loader.Loader.from_file(*paths, **kwargs)
```

Instantiate the loader with *kwargs*, load *paths*, and return it.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                   | Description                                                                                   | Default   |
|----------|--------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| *paths   | [SourceLike](`timetoalign.loader._sources.SourceLike`) | Filesystem paths or members of ZIP archives (``zipfile.Path``), as :meth:`load` takes them.   | `()`      |
| **kwargs | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                    | Passed to the loader's constructor, ``seed`` among them (the seed of the loader's ID minter). | `{}`      |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from zipfile import Path as ZipPath
>>> member = ZipPath("corpus.zip", at="corpus/measures/piece.measures.tsv")
>>> loader = Ms3Loader.from_file(member)
```

### load { #timetoalign.loader.Loader.load }

```python
loader.Loader.load(*sources)
```

Load and accept one or more sources through the shared template.

Each source is a filesystem path (``Path`` or ``str``) or a member of
a ZIP archive (``zipfile.Path``), which is read without extracting
the archive. Its entry in ``metadata["sources"]`` records ``path``
(for a member: the archive's absolute path, and ``member``, the
member's path inside it) and ``loaded_at``.

Every ID the loader mints (events, timelines, maps, MatchClaims,
Projections) comes from its :class:`~timetoalign.core.ids.IdMinter`,
in the order the loader builds them. Every ``load`` call seeds a
new one: the first call after the loader is made or cleared from
the loader's ``seed`` when one was given, else from
:func:`~timetoalign.core.ids.seed_from` of the loader's class name,
its configuration (the constructor arguments that shape the
events) and the SHA-256 digests of the call's sources, in order;
every later call from ``seed_from`` of the previous call's seed and
its own sources' digests, so later sources count too. A fresh
loader loading unchanged sources in the same calls mints the same
IDs, in any process; IDs the source states are kept as they are.

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                  |
|--------|------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [FileNotFoundError](`FileNotFoundError`) | If a ``zipfile.Path`` names a member its archive does not hold.                                                                                              |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`)               | If the loader reads one source and is given none or more than one, or any while it holds one (after ``clear()`` it reads one again). Nothing is parsed then. |
